method.calendar: Each period requires identical unique chronological account dates across all configurations, all registered years, and no dates outside the account period.
method.concentration: Instrument market values / total NAV, including cash in denominator; post-market-move weights can exceed target caps.
method.costs: Fees debit cash; slippage is embedded in execution prices and is not deducted twice.
method.formal_families: All four registered families retained as not-ready p=1 placeholders; no endpoint is selected or aggregated from exploratory contrasts.
method.inference: 100k/base R0-E0 and R1-E1 for both scalings, separately by period; HAC-studentized null-centered circular block bootstrap, 5000 draws, main60 and sensitivity20/120. Marginal exploratory intervals, no multiplicity-confirmed significance.
method.ledger: Independent event/position arithmetic; not independent price or source-fact verification. Pre-NAV share metadata is excluded from account entries.
method.sharpe: 252-session annualization and zero cash return; no risk-free or factor adjustment.
method.stress: Every path is compared with its matching base. Changed fills and cash constraints can make stress directions non-monotonic; no outcome is dropped.
method.timing: Anchor D, decision D+1, baseline execution D+2; delay2 executes D+3 (trading sessions).
method.turnover: Sum of 0.5 * absolute daily filled notional / prior NAV; annualized by 252/session count.
method.yearly: Year returns compound; year CNY NAV changes / initial capital are additive contributions.
